create.name: Samaneri Jayasāra
create.bio:
Samaneri Jayasāra is a ten-precept Buddhist nun in the Theravāda forest tradition who lives at Viveka Hermitage, a small monastic house near Mount Gulaga on the far south coast of New South Wales, which she shares with Ayya Jitindriyā. She first took robes as an eight-precept anagarikā in 2002, training at Dhammasara in Western Australia and at Amaravati and Cittaviveka in England, and took up the robe again as a samaneri in 2018, spending the next years at Santi Forest Monastery in New South Wales and helping it grow as a place for women monastics. Before ordaining she earned a doctorate in education, researching how spiritual traditions, Buddhism and psychotherapy meet, and taught psychology and counselling at university level.

She is best known for Wisdom of the Masters, a YouTube channel she began from the hermitage, where she reads aloud passages from Buddhist, Advaita, Dzogchen, Taoist, Sufi and Christian contemplatives, alongside her own guided meditations and yoga nidra practices. Her approach leans towards the non-dual: resting in awareness, self-enquiry and silence. The hermitage cannot host guests, so she teaches in person through occasional silent retreats at Kamalashila Buddhist Centre near Tilba, and shares guided meditations freely on Insight Timer and the hermitage website.

courses.title: Shamatha–Vipassana (Calm & Insight) Retreat: Developing Meditation from Wisdom
courses.description: A four-day, mostly silent retreat at Kamalashila Buddhist Centre near Tilba, taught jointly with Ayya Jitindriyā. It looks at how calm and insight support each other when grounded in right view, with group question-and-answer sessions; booking is through the Drogmi Buddhist Institute.
courses.price: $390 AUD off-site, $420 AUD camping on site (meals included)

free_resources.title: Samaneri Jayasāra on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile gathers guided meditations on silence, presence and insight, plus several yoga nidra practices. Every track is free to play.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations from Viveka Hermitage
free_resources.description: A page of some thirty recorded meditations by Samaneri Jayasāra, from breath and body practices to resting in awareness and Tilopa's six points, alongside series from Ayya Jitindriyā. Each can be streamed or downloaded at no cost.

flags: Email is published as 'vivekahermitage[at]gmail[dot]com' on the contact page; written out here, not guessed. It is the shared hermitage inbox for her and Ayya Jitindriyā.
Shares Viveka Hermitage, the retreat and the hermitage website with Ayya Jitindriyā, who is not on Spiritpedia or in this sprint; she could be a separate listing later.

Most of her YouTube channel (241K) is her reading aloud the texts of other masters, rather than her own talks; the videos chosen are the most viewed of the latest 30 and include several readings (Nisargadatta, Fire Sermon) plus her own guided practices. A human may prefer only her own guided meditations.
Only one photo confirmed (her About page, 372x382); the YouTube avatar is a Guanyin statue.
City set to Tilba (her retreat venue near the hermitage); Insight Timer lists Sydney. The hermitage itself takes no guests.
The hermitage home page shows a post 'A Conversation about Depression' (an Ayya Jitindriyā interview); it is not sold and is not linked from the plan.
